attributes.board_name: South Carolina State Board of Dentistry

rules.accepted_credit_types: Programs developed or endorsed by ADA, AGD, ADHA, ADAA, NADL or their societies, ADA-recognized specialty organizations, ADA-accredited dental schools, or others approved by the Board. 1 hour = 50 minutes
rules.new_licensee_rule: Licensed by examination in South Carolina: exempt for the first relicensure period.
rules.audit_note: Certify hours on the renewal form; keep course records 3 years and provide certificates on request.

topics.who: Dentists authorized to prescribe controlled substances: prescribing and monitoring Schedule II-IV (S.C. Code §40-15-145)
CPR recertification every 2 years; max 4 CE hours

rules.notes: At least 50% live/in person (interactive webinars count as live); rest may be online. CPR recertification every 2 years required; max 4 CE hours for a CPR course. Teaching credit up to 25%. Dentists using sedation (S.C. Code §40-15-420): 4 h every 2 years in pharmacology, anesthesia, emergency medicine or sedation.
